programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Brian Greene: Is our universe the only universe?
programme.desc: Is there more than one universe? In this visually rich, action-packed talk, Brian Greene shows how the unanswered questions of physics (starting with a big one: What caused the Big Bang?) have led to the theory that our own universe is just one of many in the "multiverse."TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Britta Riley: A garden in my apartment
programme.desc: Britta Riley wanted to grow her own food (in her tiny apartment). So she and her friends developed a system for growing plants in discarded plastic bottles -- researching, testing and tweaking the system using social media, trying many variations at once and quickly arriving at the optimal system. Call it distributed DIY. And the results? Delicious.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: James Randi's fiery takedown of psychic fraud
programme.desc: Legendary skeptic James Randi takes a fatal dose of homeopathic sleeping pills onstage, kicking off a searing 18-minute indictment of irrational beliefs. He throws out a challenge to the world's psychics: Prove what you do is real, and I'll give you a million dollars. (No takers yet.)TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.desc: Paved roads are nice to look at, but they’re easily damaged and costly to repair. Erik Schlangen demos a new type of porous asphalt made of simple materials with an astonishing feature: When cracked, it can be “healed” by induction heating. (Filmed at TEDxDelft.)TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Afra Raymond: Three myths about corruption
programme.desc: Trinidad and Tobago amassed great wealth in the 1970s thanks to oil. But in 1982, a shocking fact was revealed -- that 2 out of every 3 dollars earmarked for development had been wasted or stolen. This has haunted Afra Raymond for 30 years. Shining a flashlight on a continued history of government corruption, Raymond gives us a reframing of financial crime. (Filmed at TEDxPortofSpain.)TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: David Pizarro: The strange politics of disgust
programme.desc: What does a disgusting image have to do with how you vote? Equipped with surveys and experiments, psychologist David Pizarro demonstrates a correlation between sensitivity to disgusting cues -- a photo of feces, an unpleasant odor -- and moral and political conservatism. (Filmed at TEDxEast.)TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Trevor Aaronson: How this FBI strategy is actually creating US-based terrorists
programme.desc: There's an organization responsible for more terrorism plots in the United States than al-Qaeda, al-Shabaab and ISIS combined: The FBI. How? Why? In an eye-opening talk, investigative journalist Trevor Aaronson reveals a disturbing FBI practice that breeds terrorist plots by exploiting Muslim-Americans with mental health problems.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Civic Tech and the Sad Story of Freedom of Information in Hungary
programme.desc: «Átlátszó,» the word means «transparent» in Hungarian, and it is the name of Hungary's first independent investigative journalism website. A watchdog non-government organisation (NGO) which has experimented with introducing Civic Tech solutions in order to facilitate the work of its team, and also to provide citizens with empowering tools. Since Atlatszo.hu was launched in 2011, the Freedom of Information Act has received a lot of attention, and the legal way for questioning public bodies about spending, a «Freedom of Information request» has become the tool for many to reveal information about corruption.Marietta Le will showcase the use of the free software system Alaveteli, and the use of the Freedom of Information Act in Hungary. The law has been changed since 2011, and the latest news is about a threat that would make access to information much harder for Hungarian citizens. Meanwhile, Atlatszo.hu and many others are trying to implement new Civic Tech solutions in Hungary to help people exercise their democratic rights.Marietta Le is an FOI advocate at Atlatszo.hu Hungarian investigative journalism website. She also works with the K-Monitor anti-corruption NGO as a project coordinator to «Be Smart with Data», a program that facilitates NGOs in producing web apps and visualisations using open data. In 2015 the Hungarian Forbes magazine has featured her on their «30 under 30» list for starting «Jarokelo.hu», a street fixing website in Hungary.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Marco Tempest: A cyber-magic card trick like no other
programme.desc: The suits, numbers and colors in a deck of cards correspond to the seasons, moon cycles and calendar. Marco Tempest straps on augmented reality goggles and does a card trick like you’ve never seen before, weaving a lyrical tale as he deals. (This version fixes a glitch in the original performance, but is otherwise exactly as seen live by the TEDGlobal audience, including the dazzling augmented reality effects.)TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Keith Chen: Could your language affect your ability to save money?
programme.desc: What can economists learn from linguists? Behavioral economist Keith Chen introduces a fascinating pattern from his research: that languages without a concept for the future -- "It rain tomorrow," instead of "It will rain tomorrow" -- correlate strongly with high savings rates. Read more about Chen’s explorations »TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED

programme.title: Practical Protocol-Oriented Programming in Swift
programme.desc: Value types are at the core of Swift (seriously, mostly everything in the Swift standard library is a value type). But how do you avoid subclassing? That's where the power of Protocol-Oriented programming comes in. Learn how to structure your code to (almost) never subclass again! Practical everyday examples and ideas for your own code base will be included.The speaker Natasha Murashev is an iOS developer by day and a robot by night. She blogs about Swift, WatchOS, and iOS development on her blog, natashatherobot.com, and curates a fast-growing weekly Swift newsletter: This Week in Swift. In her free time, she works on personal projects, speaks at meetups and conferences, contributes to open source, and likes to cross things off her bucket list. She's currently living the digital nomad life as her alter identity: @NatashaTheNomad.

programme.title: Kommunenes digitale arkiv som et felleskomponent basert på fri programvare

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Andy Yen: Think your email's private? Think again
programme.desc: Sending an email message is like sending a postcard, says scientist Andy Yen in this thought-provoking talk: Anyone can read it. Yet encryption, the technology that protects the privacy of email communication, does exist. It's just that until now it has been difficult to install and a hassle to use. Showing a demo of an email program he designed with colleagues at CERN, Yen argues that encryption can be made simple to the point of becoming the default option, providing true email privacy to all.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Bruno Torturra: Got a smartphone? Start broadcasting
programme.desc: In 2011, journalist Bruno Torturra covered a protest in São Paulo which turned ugly. His experience of being teargassed had a profound effect on the way he thought about his work, and he quit his job to focus on broadcasting raw, unedited experiences online. In this fascinating talk, he shares some of the ways in which he's experimented with livestreaming on the web, and how in the process he has helped to create a very modern media network.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: William Noel: Revealing the lost codex of Archimedes
programme.desc: How do you read a two-thousand-year-old manuscript that has been erased, cut up, written on and painted over? With a powerful particle accelerator, of course! Ancient books curator William Noel tells the fascinating story behind the Archimedes palimpsest, a Byzantine prayer book containing previously-unknown original writings from ancient Greek mathematician Archimedes and others.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Tania Simoncelli: How I took on the gene patent industry -- and won
programme.desc: Are human genes patentable? Back in 2005, when Tania Simoncelli first contemplated this complex question, US patent law said they were — which meant patent holders had the right to stop anyone from sequencing, testing or even looking at a patented gene. Troubled by the way this law both harmed patients and created a barrier to biomedical innovation, Simoncelli and her colleagues at the ACLU challenged it. In this riveting talk, hear the story of how they took a case everybody told them they would lose all the way to the Supreme Court.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Linus Torvalds: The mind behind Linux
programme.desc: Linus Torvalds transformed technology twice — first with the Linux kernel, which helps power the Internet, and again with Git, the source code management system used by developers worldwide. In a rare interview with TED Curator Chris Anderson, Torvalds discusses with remarkable openness the personality traits that prompted his unique philosophy of work, engineering and life. "I am not a visionary, I'm an engineer," Torvalds says. "I'm perfectly happy with all the people who are walking around and just staring at the clouds ... but I'm looking at the ground, and I want to fix the pothole that's right in front of me before I fall in."TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Dan Ariely: How equal do we want the world to be? You'd be surprised
programme.desc: The news of society's growing inequality makes all of us uneasy. But why? programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Christopher Soghoian: A brief history of phone wiretapping -- and how to avoid it
programme.desc: Who is listening in on your phone calls? On a landline, it could be anyone, says privacy activist Christopher Soghoian, because surveillance backdoors are built into the phone system by default, to allow governments to listen in. But then again, so could a foreign intelligence service ... or a criminal. Which is why, says Soghoian, some tech companies are resisting governments' call to build the same backdoors into mobile phones and new messaging systems. Learn how some tech companies are working to keep your calls and messages private.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: How the Earth Was Made
programme.desc: Opprinnelsen til øygruppen Hawaii har vært en gåte gjennom mange generasjoner.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Decoded
programme.desc: Eksperter tror at en obskur skisse som ble stjålet og gjemt av en kardinal, kan ha vært en del av Da Vincis kryptiske profetier. Teamet avslører Da Vincis kontroversielle holdninger, at han var besatt av døden og mysteriet med Mona Lisas identitet.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Blir intelligente roboter en trussel mot menneskeheten eller det neste steget i evolusjonen? Er sammenføyningen av menneske og maskin en skjebne som romvesener forberedte for oss for flere tusen år siden?

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Skattejegerne Rick og Marty er på sporet av gull fra borgerkrigen som skal ha blitt konfiskert fra Jefferson Davis i 1865. Deler av det ligger på bunnen av Lake Michigan, mens noe ligger i tunnelene under Michigan og en hule i Utah.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend Of The Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Å jakte på ’Lost Dutchman’ er normalt en oppgave for én person. Wayne Tuttle har slått seg sammen med et team av eksperter for å følge nye spor. Kanskje de endelig kan løse det 500 år gamle mysteriet om Amerikas mest kjente nedgravde skatt.

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: Hannibals gjentatte angrep på romersk mark blir nesten undergangen for det fremtidige imperiet. Hannibal fra Karthago gjør det utenkelige, han leder 40 krigselefanter og en hær over Alpene for å overraske fienden.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: For alle mennesker er virkeligheten litt forskjellig, men vi er enige om at himmelen er blå, sitroner er sure og at horn er høylytte. Men hva om en av sansene dine forsterkes eller endrer seg? Og er det mulig å ha en mystisk "sjette sans"?

programme.desc: New York er en av verdens største menneskeskapte plasser, men alt fra skyskrapernes høyde til plasseringen av havnen styres av noen utrolige krefter.

programme.desc: Når jorda blir truffet av en dødelig solstorm, en stor bit av sola, kortslutter de elektriske systemene våre. Hvordan klarer den moderne sivilisasjonen seg uten strøm?

programme.desc: En ukjent morder henretter en tilsynelatende perfekt familie i deres eksklusive hjem i Florida; mens etterforsker Eva Marie Multari leter etter svar, avdekker hun skjulte familiespenninger og en manisk plan drevet av en besettende kjærlighetsaffære.

programme.title: Bodies In The Water
programme.desc: I 1985 finner politiet en bil full av blod, og leter etter en savnet 20-åring. Flere dager senere dukker liket hennes opp i Lake Springfield.

programme.desc: En ung mor blir funnet død, og bevis på et voldelig trekantdrama kommer til overflaten - det virker åpenbart hvem som står bak drapet. Sannheten er imidlertid ikke alltid åpenbar.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: En tenåring blir savnet etter å ha møtt noen på nettet, og politiet oppdager et rovdyr som er langt farligere enn de hadde forestilt seg - en seriemorder på frifot.

programme.title: Forbrytelsene som rystet USA
programme.desc: En alenemor forsvinner sporløst fra boligen sin i forstedene, og politiet avdekker et nett av løgner laget av de som stod henne nærmest.

programme.title: Forbrytelsene som rystet USA
programme.desc: Det florerer av spørsmål og beskyldninger når den 52 år gamle gründeren og fembarnsmoren Dee Warner forsvinner fra sitt hjem på landsbygda i Michigan.

programme.title: My Murder Story
programme.desc: En rekke mystiske dødsfall har plaget en liten by i Kansas. En detektiv som nekter å gi opp, gjennomfører en grundig etterforskning som avdekker en forferdelig hemmelighet.

programme.title: My Murder Story
programme.desc: Siden faren hennes ble myrdet, har den kjærlige datteren levd med hemmeligheter og spørsmål som aldri har blitt besvart. Etterforskerne avdekker en mann som lever et dobbeltliv.

programme.title: My Family's Deadly Secret
programme.desc: På valentinsdagen i 2004 forsvinner en familie fra hjemmet sitt i Vaughan, Mississippi. Michael Hargon, kona Rebecca og deres fire år gamle sønn er ikke å finne noe sted.

programme.title: My Family's Deadly Secret
programme.desc: Da den 20 år gamle studenten Cathy Torrez blir funnet død i bagasjerommet på sin egen bil, sverger familien at de ikke vil gi seg før morderen blir tatt.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: En tenåring blir savnet etter å ha møtt noen på nettet, og politiet oppdager et rovdyr som er langt farligere enn de hadde forestilt seg - en seriemorder på frifot.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: En college-student søker hjelp på nettet da livets påkjenninger begynner å tårne seg opp. Han knytter kontakt med en ung sykepleier, som viser seg å være alt annet enn en hjelper.

programme.title: A Body in the Basement
programme.desc: Politiet i Philadelphia finner fire voksne personer innelåst i en kjeller. Etterforskningen går over fire delstater og fører til flere arrestasjoner.

programme.title: A Body in the Basement
programme.desc: Et likfunn i en kjeller i California gjenåpner et flere tiår gammelt mysterium. Politiet oppdager at det er en tenåring som forsvant i 1984.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights

programme.title: David Oistrakh: Artist of the People?
programme.desc: The dramatic story of an inspired violinist, of a loyal man whose self-imposed silence eloquently betrayed unspoken private suffering. This extensive profile features interviews with David Oistrakh's longtime friends and fellow musicians: Yehudi Menuhin showing what it takes to make a great violinist; Mstislav Rostropovitch talking of Oistrakh's relationship with the Soviet regime; Gidon Kremer recalling Oistrakh as a teacher; Gennady Rozhdestvensky who conducted all the major concertos for him.

programme.title: Electronic Vibrations - A sound changes the world
programme.desc: Whether techno or hip-hop – electronic music is nowadays the driving force of pop culture. We have almost forgotten that its origins lie in the WDR’s electronic studio, which made Cologne to one of the centres of the avant-garde during the post-war years. This is the story of how a room full of strange devices would become a cabinet of curiosities, the vibrations of which sent the whole world in a state of ecstasy. From the beginnings directly after the Second World War in Paris with Pierre Schaeffer’s ‘musique concrète’, the film focuses on Stockhausen and goes on to Kraftwerk, from Jean-Michel Jarre and the IRCAM studio right up to Detroit to the beginnings of techno.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a British painter, William Turner.You will discover his labour with London from greenwich park, child hairdo’s pilgrimage, Snow storm.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Eugene Delacroix.You will discover his labour with The barque of Dante, Portrait of Aspasie, The assassination of the bishop of liege.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Située sur la place Trafalgar Square à Londres, la Galerie Nationale est la maison d’une des plus grandes collections d’art Européennes. Celle-ci contient plus de 2000 peintures, allant du Moyen âge jusqu’au début des années 2000.Vous pourrez admirer des méthodes d’art et des œuvres d’artistes uniques au monde, comme la remarquable peinture flamande (Van Eyck, Vermeer), l’impressionnisme français (Monet, Cézanne) et surtout les maîtres anglais de l’art comme Hogart et Turner.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: This gallery was built in the 16th century as the seat for Florence’s new administrative offices (uffizi), and opened to the public as the Uffizi Gallery in the 18th century. Today it still offers the world’s most beautiful collection of Italian Renaissance art. How could anyone remain insensitive to the sensual beauty of “The Birth of Venus” by Botticelli, “The Venus of Urbino” by Titian, or Correggio’s “Danae”? Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La Prison de la Santé, construite à Paris entre 1861 et 1867, est un ensemble architectural unique, homogène, imposant. À la pointe de la réflexion théorique sur l’enfermement, elle fut à son époque la "prison moderne" par excellence, la traduction en pierre des nouvelles obsessions pénitentiaires du XIXème siècle : la prison panoptique, la rationalisation et l’humanisation de la détention, la rédemption du détenu.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: The Museum of Fine Art in the city of Montpellier, in the South of France, bears the name of Francois-Xavier Fabre (1766-1837), who left his personal collection to his native town. Here you can admire the picture “Vertumnus and Permona” by Jean Ranc or “The Women of Algiers” by Delacroix. The collection includes works by the Montpellier painter Jean-Fréderic Bazille, such as his “View of a Village”, and above all paintings by Gustave Courbet, including the famous “Bonjour Monsieur Courbet”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: L’art d’Edgar Degas est difficile à classer, cependant il est souvent associé au mouvement impressionniste, qui a émergé en France à la fin du 19ème siècle. Néanmoins, il a développé un style très personnel avec une préférence pour les sujets intérieurs plutôt que les scènes en plein air favorisées par les peintres impressionnistes. Les 10 oeuvres présentées dans cet épisode illustrent parfaitement les préférences thématiques d’Edgar Degas : Le spectacle, le bain, les portraits de famille et les classes de travail. Découvrez " La Classe de danse " exposé au Musée d'Orsay ou encore " Les Danseuses bleues " au Musée des Beaux-Arts Pouchkine.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Le Havre by Auguste Perret : The concrete city
programme.desc: In this documentary, we take you to discover the city of Le Havre in Normandy, which was destroyed during the Second World War and then rebuilt according to the plans of a team led by Auguste Perret.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discuss with Philippe Barbosa, reportage and corporate photographer. The term corporate photography means that he works for companies and produces images for them. It can be to make portraits of executives, for events... These are mostly images that serve the communication of the company.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Hans Hartung" at the Museum of Modern Art in Paris. This exhibition dedicated to this 20th century painter is a retrospective from 1904, the year of his birth, until his death in 1989, where we can observe all his production that was very important in the history of art.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Emil Bührle collection at the Maillol Museum
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the Emil Bührle collection at the Maillol Museum in Paris.This collection is that of Emil Bührle, a student of art history who became passionate about collecting Monet's works after a visit to the National Gallery in Berlin. He started his collection with works by Claude Monet, but continued to fill it with works by Cézanne, Gauguin... Works that you can observe during this visit.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: ‘Girl in a White Kimono’ is a painting from Breitner's famous Kimono Girl series. As a preliminary study for his paintings, he used photographs of his model (Geesje Kwak) in kimono. To get as close as possible to the creative process of Breitner, the team will take a photo with Breitner's original camera. The camera is fantastic museum piece in the safekeeping of Leiden University. It turns out to be a complicated chemical process with glass negatives and slow shutter speeds. Charlotte finds out that she needs a certain medium to be able to complete the reconstruction properly. Michel investigates and ends up in Cambridge; looking for a recipe in the archives of an old paint shop.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Dans la seconde moitié du 19ème siècle, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) démontre une grande originalité dans ses peintures à représentation historique et ses portraits représentant des figures connues, comme le romancier Zola et le poète Mallarmé. Même s’il n’est pas reconnu comme étant le premier impressionniste, sa place de leader dans l’histoire de l’art se doit d’être souligné. Les scandales provoqués en 1863 par « Le Déjeuner sur l’herbe » ou « Olympia » tout deux exposés au Musée d'Orsay marque le début de la peinture moderne.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: Un événement remarquable s'est produit à la National Gallery de Londres lorsque la plus grande collection jamais constituée de peintures de Léonard de Vinci a été réunie dans une exposition unique : Léonard de Vinci : peintre à la cour de Milan. Léonard est reconnu comme étant peut-être le plus grand peintre et sculpteur de tous les temps, mais ses talents ne s'arrêtaient pas là. Ce film raconte sa vie et s'étend sur Léonard le visionnaire, Léonard l'inventeur. Depuis l'endroit où il a vécu ses dernières années au Château du Clos Lucé en France, nous verrons que Léonard de Vinci était peut-être l'incarnation même de l'esprit de la Renaissance.

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test your knowledge and your memory in fine arts, architecture, photography, street art and a dozen other topics with our Art Quiz popups !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: S’inspirant de personnages familiers, Gustave Courbet a érigé les gens simples au rang de la peinture d’histoire… Il a aussi su mettre le corps féminin à l’honneur avec sa célèbre Origine du monde… Si son audace, associée à un naturalisme sans concession, a bien souvent fait scandale, c’est elle qui a fait sa notoriété. Avec des tableaux tels que Le sommeil, L’enterrement à Ornans ou bien L’atelier du peintre, cette exposition vous dévoile l’œuvre du chef de file du courant réaliste. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Eugène Delacroix is considered as the leader of French Romanticism, a simultaneously passionate, dramatic and tormented artistic movement, which emerged at the beginning of the 19th century. However, more than a movement, it is a whole creative and captivating artistic development, which is on offer here, through the study of 10 of the artist’s major works. He was to have a notable influence on all modern artistic movements, which after him, were to explore the power of colour and light. Discover " Liberty leading the people " or " The death of Sardanapalus " exposed at the Louvre.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this series is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Edgar Degas.You will discover his labour with Portrait of hilaire rené Degas, race horses, ballet rehearsal on the set.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherland painter, Vincent van Gogh.You will discover his labour with Self-portrait, Memory of the garden at Etten, Van Gogh’s chair.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Peintre originaire de Florence en Italie, Sandro Botticelli est considéré comme l’un des peintres Italiens les plus connus du 15ème siècle. Proche de la famille Medici, il est admiré et renommé pour ses portraits et ses peintures de femmes nues tout droit inspirées de la mythologie grecques comme le majestic tableau « La naissance de Vénus », exhibé dans la Gallery Uffizi à Florence, et également présent dans cet épisode.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Le musée du Petit-Palais a été construit à Paris pour l’Exposition Universelle de 1900, en même temps que le Grand Palais. La collection comprend des chefs-d’œuvre comme le Portrait de l’artiste en costume oriental de Rembrandt, le Port de mer au soleil couchant du Lorrain ou les Trois baigneuses de Cézanne. C’est également là qu’on peut admirer le fameux et très sensuel Sommeil de Gustave Courbet. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Joyau de géométrie et de rigueur, cette bibliothèque est l'un des derniers chefs-d'œuvre de Louis Kahn. En disposant les lecteurs sur la périphérie du bâtiment, près de la lumière du jour, et en créant un immense hall central, Louis Kahn réinvente le plan de la bibliothèque. Achevée en 1971 dans la petite ville d'Exeter, dans l'État américain du New Hampshire, la bibliothèque de l'Exeter Academy forme un mystérieux monolithe de brique aux 4 façades identiques sur 8 étages.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Housing a huge collection of European paintings from the Renaissance at the end of the 18th century, the Alte Pinakothek in Munich brims over with masterpieces. In particular it boasts several paintings by the great Flemish artist, Rubens, such as “The Battle of the Amazons”. Notice as well Durer’s “Paumgartner Altarpiece”, the impressive “Battle of Alexander at Issus” by the painter Altdofer, and also the “Land of Cockaigne” by Pieter Bruegel the Elder. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Probablement le peintre le plus renommé du monde, Vincent van Gogh est née aux Pays-Bas en 1853 mais a passé la plus grande partie de sa vie en France.Souffrant de trouble mental, Van Gogh a produit plus de 2000 peintures avant de se suicider à l’âge de 37 ans. Pendant cette visite, vous allez pouvoir découvrir ses plus grandes oeuvres, avec notamment deux « Auto-portraits » exposé au Musée d'Orsay, « Les Tournesols » exposé à la Galere Nationale de Londres, « La Nuit étoilée », et « L’église d’Auvers-sur-Oise ».Bonne visite !

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: ‘Girl in a White Kimono’ is a painting from Breitner's famous Kimono Girl series. As a preliminary study for his paintings, he used photographs of his model (Geesje Kwak) in kimono. To get as close as possible to the creative process of Breitner, the team will take a photo with Breitner's original camera. The camera is fantastic museum piece in the safekeeping of Leiden University. It turns out to be a complicated chemical process with glass negatives and slow shutter speeds. Charlotte finds out that she needs a certain medium to be able to complete the reconstruction properly. Michel investigates and ends up in Cambridge; looking for a recipe in the archives of an old paint shop.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Léonard De Vinci est le peintre Italien de la renaissance le plus célèbre. Il possède un talent inégalable (peintre, sculpteur, architecte, ingénieur, urbaniste, mathématicien, botaniste, philosophe, inventeur,…) Il a considérablement influencé l’histoire de l’art. Son usage de la technique Sfumato et du clair-obscur son encore étudié aujourd’hui. La « Mona Lisa » et « La Cène » exposé au Louvre et dans l'église Santa Maria delle Grazie qui apparaissent dans cet épisode font partie de ses peintures les plus renommé, admiré et parodié à travers le monde.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans l’Ouest de la banlieue parisienne, nous allons à la découverte de l’atelier de l’artiste Jérôme Zonder. Depuis plus de 10 ans, l’artiste développe un travail virtuose centré sur le dessin. Réalisés au fusain ou à la mine de graphite, ses œuvres sombres et souvent très réalistes suscitent à la fois admiration et effroi. Puissant et complexe, l’art de Jérôme Zonder captive par ses prouesses techniques et questionne notre rapport à la violence.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Pierre Morel, a photojournalist. He started this job very young and considers it a way of commitment and activism. What interests him is to have the point of view of several photographers on the society and he tries to give his own point of view in his turn.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Barbara Hepworth" at the Rodin Museum in Paris. This exhibition is dedicated to one of the most important figures of the sculpture of the first half of the 20th century. During this visit you will be able to see some of his emblematic works such as "symbol form".

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Hey ! Modern art & pop culture" at the Halle Saint-Pierre in Paris. This is the fourth exhibition on these themes of modern art and pop culture. You will find a wide variety of works such as Paul Toupet or The Kid, artists who are not very well known but whose works are worth a look.

Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.sub-title: Che Peng-Fei - The Painter of Poetry
programme.desc: Che Peng Fei sublimates traditional Chinese painting by charging it with a unique poetic sensibility. His art, inspired by nature and philosophy, evokes a rich, contemplative inner world.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Probablement le peintre le plus renommé du monde, Vincent van Gogh est née aux Pays-Bas en 1853 mais a passé la plus grande partie de sa vie en France.Souffrant de trouble mental, Van Gogh a produit plus de 2000 peintures avant de se suicider à l’âge de 37 ans. Pendant cette visite, vous allez pouvoir découvrir ses plus grandes oeuvres, avec notamment deux « Auto-portraits » exposé au Musée d'Orsay, « Les Tournesols » exposé à la Galere Nationale de Londres, « La Nuit étoilée », et « L’église d’Auvers-sur-Oise ».Bonne visite !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: L’art d’Edgar Degas est difficile à classer, cependant il est souvent associé au mouvement impressionniste, qui a émergé en France à la fin du 19ème siècle. Néanmoins, il a développé un style très personnel avec une préférence pour les sujets intérieurs plutôt que les scènes en plein air favorisées par les peintres impressionnistes. Les 10 oeuvres présentées dans cet épisode illustrent parfaitement les préférences thématiques d’Edgar Degas : Le spectacle, le bain, les portraits de famille et les classes de travail. Découvrez " La Classe de danse " exposé au Musée d'Orsay ou encore " Les Danseuses bleues " au Musée des Beaux-Arts Pouchkine.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.desc: Dans cet épisode de Fais ton Sport à la Maison, Sabrina et Guigui vous embarquent pour une séance spéciale fessiers pleine d’énergie et de bonne humeur. L’échauffement met l’accent sur les articulations du bas du corps : chevilles, genoux, hanches et lombaires. L’objectif ? Mobiliser en douceur pour préparer vos muscles à l'effort. Entre blagues complices et conseils précis, la team vous guide avec bienveillance. Une session idéale pour activer, tonifier et réveiller les fessiers tout en s’amusant.

Use the breath to align your posture and learn to experience your practice, rather than thinking it through. Asanas, the physical yoga poses, then become a practice of feeling more than a mental exercise.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Now it's Fred's turn, a 35-year-old from Liège, to enter the competition. Underneath his serene exterior, this young educator for children with a passion for decoration hides a very speedy temperament. And to make the most of his hyperactivity, there's only one solution: decorating. Fred knows what he wants, both in his decorating style and in life.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan panacakes.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Forests play a vital role in the fragile balance we form with nature. It is essential to humanity, yet since man first appeared on Earth, he has destroyed 50% of the planet's forests. We discover the great mysteries of nature, from Madagascar to Brazil, Australia and Mexico. From butterflies, to hidden tribes, to lemurs or Lyre birds, a breathtaking diversity of living beings.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode de Fais ton Sport à la Maison, Sabrina et Guigui vous embarquent pour une séance spéciale fessiers pleine d’énergie et de bonne humeur. L’échauffement met l’accent sur les articulations du bas du corps : chevilles, genoux, hanches et lombaires. L’objectif ? Mobiliser en douceur pour préparer vos muscles à l'effort. Entre blagues complices et conseils précis, la team vous guide avec bienveillance. Une session idéale pour activer, tonifier et réveiller les fessiers tout en s’amusant.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo reçoit Delphine Malachard, qui est intolérante au gluten. Ensemble, elles vont donc cuisiner des recettes sans gluten. Au menu : soufflé au chocolat et financiers à la vanille et aux fruits rouges.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo cuisine la reine des protéines végétales : la lentille. Bonne pour la santé, digeste et délicieuse, elle remplace la viande et le poisson. Nous allons préparer des galettes de lentilles corail aux épices, avec une sauce au yaourt et à la menthe. Et pour la suite, un classique de la cuisine française : une salade de lentilles vertes avec de la saucisse de Morteau.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her pastry chef friend Laurent Favre-Mot prepare desserts from our childhood. On the program: panettone in French toast, and torta della nonna with lemon cream and pine nuts, a typical Italian dessert!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous allons voyager au Mexique avec les fajitas ! Un plat typique de la cuisine tex-mex. On va préparer ensemble des tortillas (galettes de maïs). Et pour la suite, des fajitas avec du poulet, des poivrons et des épices.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: India - The Search for Mindfulness Part II
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.desc: We're still in New Zealand, where we look at the scientific and emotional benefits of water, illustrated by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection with aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we discover how New Zealand's abundant waters are more than just a natural spectacle; they're a source of holistic health and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In our season premiere we tackle the riveting question: How is it that some people have been able to reach the pinnacle of our human performance? Guided by Dr. David Behm, an expert in sports physiology, we venture into the lab to uncover the fascinating intersection of science and athletic performance. Then we take this theoretical knowledge into the real world, visiting a high-performance training facility where professional NHL athletes are honing their skills. There, we join forces with Ben Prentiss, founder of Prentiss Hockey Performance, to not only witness these athletes in action but also to understand how the principles of peak performance can translate into our daily lives for enhanced strength and well-being. We hear from the athletes themselves including Stanley Cup Champions and All-Star players about their philosophy on what health means to them. This episode offers an insider's look into the world of elite training, demystifying the science and practices that enable ath.

programme.desc: Den Emmy-belønte filmen til Dereck og Beverly Joubert er tilbake i remastret utgave. Med den utrolige fortellerstemmen til Jeremy Irons fortelles en fantastisk historie om konflikten mellom løver og hyener, der mye ikke var kjent fra tidligere. Det spente forholdet og rivaliteten mellom de to artene preger kampen for å overleve.

programme.title: The Living Edens
programme.desc: I India kjemper en tigerfamilie om makten i ruinene av et tapt imperium. Den unge hannen B1 utfordrer bestefaren for å bli flokkens leder. Han vil utnytte den aldrende tigerens svekkede reflekser og nedsatte syn. B1s mor prøver å bevare freden for ungene og faren, som blir stadig mer hjelpeløs. Men B1 er fast bestemt på å overta tronen og innlede sin regjeringstid i hjertet av antikkens India.

programme.title: Verdens mest berømte tiger

programme.title: Russlands ville tiger
programme.desc: Filmen forteller om de store kattedyrenes kamp, og vi får vite flere detaljer om livet deres. Byttedyrene er også med, for tigeren hadde ikke klart seg uten sikahjort, altai-wapiti, villsvin og kragebjørn. En tigerunge blir født i en nasjonalpark, og den vil lede oss gjennom filmen. Vi følger tigeren i årene etter at han har forlatt moren. Jakten på et territorium avslører problemene som tigrene stilles overfor helt øst i Russland, og det oppstår konflikter da han nærmer seg menneskelige bosetninger. Den unge tigeren tar oss med til stedene der den sibirske tigerens skjebne avgjøres: store skoger, fjerne landsbyer og byer i utkanten av villmarken.

programme.desc: Turister fanger de beste øyeblikkene i villmarken med telefonene sine, og de store kattedyrere står øverst på alles ønskeliste på safari. Hold deg fast når en elefant angriper med en løve på støttennene. Se hannleoparder kjempe om revir, og vær obs på en leopardmors jaktskole. Geparder konfronterer krokodiller for å beskytte måltidet sitt. Store bøffelflokker samles mens en enslig løve viser hvorfor han er kongen.

programme.title: Iberia's Woodlands
programme.desc: Rivalisering definerer alt liv i skogene på den Iberiske halvøy. Ankomsten av sommeren markerer starten på det som vil være en forlenget periode med tørke i regionen, noe som gjør overlevelse enda vanskeligere for dyrene som kaller dette stedet sitt hjem. Hver skapning må kjempe for begrensede ressurser – noe som gjør konkurranse både innad i og mellom arter uunngåelig.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Etter at støvet fra den store gnumigrasjonen i Masai Mara legger seg, blir tusenvis av dyr igjen. Fra juli til oktober, når gnuene strømmer gjennom Mara, søker det fastboende dyrelivet ly i sine egne territorier og skjermet fra kaoset. Nå er de endelig frie og kan bevege seg rundt i et gnufritt Mara. Vi avslører hvordan disse utrolige dyrene lever livene sine frem til neste juli måned.

programme.desc: I Sørishavet og Indiahavet huser Sør-Georgia, Bouvet-, Marion- og Crozetøya noen av verdens største bestander av seler og pingviner. Dyrene har tilpasset seg til det iskalde vannet og kommer til øyene for å pare seg. Men de blir forfulgt av et rovdyr: spekkhoggeren.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Etter at støvet fra den store gnumigrasjonen i Masai Mara legger seg, blir tusenvis av dyr igjen. programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Etter at regnet kommer tilbake, forvandles det fredfulle Mara. Elvevannet stiger og brer seg ut over slettene, og flomlegger gresslettene og gjør paradis om til fare. Når det endelig blir skyfri himmel finner vi en servalmor som har klart seg, men hiet hennes har ikke. Mot alle odds har ungen hennes også overlevd – et virkelig mirakel under slike forhold.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Store kattedyr ses kanskje på som den ultimate klisjéen for ville dyr, men de er midt i en global kamp for å overleve. De er sterke og farlige, og nå går de i klinsj med mennesker mer enn noensinne. Denne ville safarien avslører deres motstands- og tilpasningsdyktighet. Geparder jakter fra biler, jaguarer sniker seg innpå bytte under vann og rundt båter, og Indias løver jakter i byens gater. Kjente arter og oppførsler skaper nytt drama, med avsløringer som bekrefter hvorfor store pattedyr er de farligste rovdyrene.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land Of Leopards
programme.desc: I viltreservatet Mashatu i Botswana, et av de siste fristedene for frittgående leoparder, føder en mor to unger. Hun vil gjøre alt for å beskytte dem. Men når klimaendringer strammer grepet, forsvinner ressurser, og en tøff leopardkrig er i emming. Denne filmen er basert på tre år med nøye observasjon, og avdekker sjeldne og utrolige bilder av oppførsel som ikke tidligere har blitt dokumentert, og tilbyr et helt nytt innblikk i motstandsdyktigheten og hemmelighetene til denne sky arten.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dr. Pol og de ansatte må handle raskt for å behandle en rekke pasienter som velter inn på klinikken. Etter en rask titt på et sår, må dr. Pol til operasjonsstua for en hasteoperasjon. Mens dr. Nicole sliter med armene fulle av nydelige valper som skal undersøkes, kommer alles evner til nytte når nye tilfeller ankommer klinikken.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: To lignende tilfeller skaper trøbbel, men dr. Pol og dr. Lisa er en ustoppelig duo. Sammen hjelper de en hest med en mystisk kul, og de undersøker en haug med valper. Dr. Lisa behandler så en annen hest, mens dr. Pol bistår en venn med fuglene. To veterinærer er bedre enn én når flere skadde hunder kommer til klinikken.

programme.desc: Dennis søker i Manitoba-villmarken etter en isbjørnhule i håp om å fange de første øyeblikkene til en unges liv i naturen.

programme.title: Isbjørnenes kongerike
programme.desc: Dennis følger en hunnbjørn med to unger som skal ta den farlige ferden over isen, før de stilles overfor enda større utfordringer.
